_comment: Pinned Ed25519 PUBLIC keys that may sign .vlib libraries. The matching PRIVATE key is grid's VLIB_SIGNING_KEY (kept in ~/.volt/secrets/vlib-signing.pem, never committed). Empty keys = fail-closed. To rotate: add the new public key 'active', ship the IDE, then mark the old one 'revoked'. Libraries signed by a removed key stop verifying.
